about.title: Jurupa Valley Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Jurupa Valley recorded 13 traffic deaths alongside 604 injury collisions in the most recent final crash year, numbers that represent real families across Riverside County navigating sudden, unimaginable loss. When a death results from a crash on corridors like Mission Boulevard, Van Buren Boulevard, or SR-60, surviving spouses, domestic partners, children, or other eligible dependents may have a path to pursue a wrongful death claim. California law gives these claims a two-year window from the date of death, though claims against a government entity move on a much shorter clock. We handle wrongful death claims and can evaluate the circumstances, explain who qualifies to bring a claim, and walk through next steps at no upfront cost. You focus on your family. Let us look into the rest.

whyChoose.title: Why Jurupa Valley Families Choose Us

items.title: Standing Rules Can Be Confusing
items.desc: California limits who may file a wrongful death claim, generally starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children before other dependents or heirs. We can clarify where you fit before time becomes an issue.

items.title: The Two-Year Clock Moves Fast
items.desc: Wrongful death claims in California generally must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity is involved. Getting in touch with us early helps preserve your options.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law allows families to seek funeral costs and lost financial support, but also recognizes the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. Our team can help make sure the full scope of loss is considered.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have first priority to file. If none exist, certain other dependents or heirs may be eligible under California law. We can review your specific family situation to explain where you stand.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case?
items.answer: No, they're separate. A criminal case, if one is filed, is brought by the state and focused on punishment; a wrongful death claim is a civil action a family can pursue for their own losses. One can proceed independently of the other.

items.question: Does it matter that the crash happened on a road like SR-60 or Limonite Avenue in Jurupa Valley?
items.answer: The specific corridor doesn't change the legal standard, but details about the location, time, and circumstances can matter for gathering evidence. Jurupa Valley sees a mix of local roads and state highways, and we can look into public records and reports tied to the specific crash.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk with us?
items.answer: Nothing. Our initial consultation is free, and we typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. There's no obligation to move forward after an initial conversation.
